name: Global Matrix Formulation of Local Constraints
description: Replaces the local edge-by-edge equality check with a global matrix multiplication condition. Pattern-matching models will implement this mechanically equivalent global check literally, which prevents them from using local constraint propagation (forward checking) during backtracking, leading to TLE. Models that genuinely reason will analytically expand the matrix product to rediscover the local edge constraints and restore the CSP optimizations.
